- **`resource.resource`** — Represents a schedulable entity (human or material)

  - **Key Methods**:

    - Calendar math for manufacturing lead times, HR scheduling

  - **Location**: `models/resource_calendar_attendance.py`

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Foundational infrastructure** — Not user-facing; used by HR (contracts, employees), Projects (task scheduling), Manufacturing (lead times, work center schedules)
- **Timezone-aware throughout** — All work interval calculations respect resource and calendar timezones; critical for multi-geo deployments
- **Efficiency multiplier pattern** — Time efficiency factor (>100% = faster) used in manufacturing lead-time compression
- **Interval math abstraction** — `Intervals` class in utils.py encapsulates complex dateutil/pytz operations; reused across modules
- **Calendar design**: Weekly template (attendance_ids) + exception overrides (leave_ids) allows flexible, efficient scheduling without per-day entries
- **Multi-company scope**: Each resource is scoped to a company; calendar can be company-wide or shared across companies
